# Open Design — seven cardinal sins (summary)

Attributed summary of https://github.com/nexu-io/open-design/blob/main/craft/anti-ai-slop.md — prefer upstream for enforcement details.

1. Default indigo/violet accent hexes
2. Purple→blue (etc.) trust gradient on hero
3. Emoji as feature icons
4. Sans/Inter on display when display face is bound
5. Rounded card + colored left border
6. Invented metrics without sources
7. Lorem / feature-one-two-three filler
